This was the most single-handedly, life-provoking thing that I have ever bore to witness. For it was its palmy visuals, stellar story, and most riveting, it's cutthroat gameplay. The terror felt as you meander down the corridors of the Haphazard Railroad have been the one of the most scariest gaming moments I've endured. If it wasn't for my unrelenting faith in Zoran, I would not have made it. BLESSED  BE ALL FROM ZORAN! 

Is was such a phenomenal game that I'm already suffering from withdrawls, but yet I know I mustn't come back. My nerves are at its wits ends, despite only having played it for a a little under an hour. That's how you know you've played a great game. Every time I close my eyes, I see them.
Wiggling, writhing masses of pure ectasy. MMmmmmmhhhhhh
I.
Love.
Worms. 



I haven't been entirely honest with you guys, this game sucked. This game was horrible, but... I had to say what I did.
I Love worms. 
And I don't mean in a "Wow, look a cool bug!"
No,  I mean in a way where when I look at worms, I am ONLY able to see a future
I want to breed worms. I yearn for a worm child


My ideal worm physique is that of a a daintily woman head, with a voluptuous curvature that makes my mind go into a whirl! 
And don't get me even started on the legs. The pencil-thin, hundred-in-number, legs that I NEED to wrap around me.
I can't undersell how much I yearn for it's tickling charm. There isn't enough words in the English language to properly convey how much this is consuming me. 
When I say I need it, I NEED IT, and that's what this game has done for me.
I've always known this, that I belong not of Man, but of worms. 
I'll settle one day in the garden of Everclear and there I shall bear with family, full of worms! 
If I have son, I shall name him Azagoth 
If a daughter, I shall name her Jhavia 
I will pleasure my wife in all her slimy, wormy crevices 
I'm not afraid to lubricate 


Likewise, I'm not crazy 
Don't be like all the others who push THE Warden Bill down just because you're jealous of the game he can pull.
Every time I go outside, I find a worm 
Name them, and put a little bow tie on him
And when fantasy is fulfilled that night, I take it off of them and put it on me

I'm not crazy. I love worms
I love nature
DOn't put me down, just because you hate the turtles 
YOU ALL SNIVLING, WORM-HATING, ANDROGYNOUS-INDUCING, FEAR MONGERING, FINGER WAGGING, PUPPY SMASHING, ♥♥♥♥♥ SORCERING VERMIN WHO CAN'T HANDLE WORM-HUMAN RELTATIONS.

THERE IS NOTHING WRONG WITH ME

10/10 Game, It reminds me of Pulled Pork
